shrimps text index | photo index Phylum Arthropoda

Subphylum Crustacea > Class Malacostraca > Order Decapoda prawns and shrimps > Family Alpheidae Commensal snapping shrimp
awaiting identification*
Family Alpheidaeupdated Dec 2019

Where seen? This tiny snapping shrimp is often found under stones and inside sponges. Often found in pairs.

Features: Body 1-2cm long. Usually translucent pale with tiny dark spots.

White snapping shrimps are also often seen in ball soft corals.

Changi, Jun 11

Changi, May 08
Under a stone.

*Species are difficult to positively identify without close examination.
